This organic cotton t-shirt is the one you reach for every morning. It is soft from the first wear, keeps its shape after many washes, and looks sharp under a jacket or on its own.

We knit it from 180 gsm combed organic cotton, so it feels thick but still breathes on hot days. The collar is taped and the side seams are double stitched, which stops twisting after washing.

  • 180 gsm organic cotton, GOTS certified
  • Regular fit; model is 180 cm and wears size M
  • Pre-shrunk: less than 3% shrinkage at 30 °C
  • Taped neck and double-stitched seams
  • Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

Pick your usual size. If you are between sizes, choose the larger one for a relaxed look. Need help? Our team replies on WhatsApp within an hour during the day.

Every organic cotton t-shirt ships in a recycled mailer and comes with a 30 day exchange on size. Wear it, wash it and tell us what you think.
